decision.reviewing: Which next candidate to build after EGO4096 failed
options: H1 EGO2048 independent-seed replication (staged lane rep; admits when storage clears)
H2 partner pool in self-play (implementing now; default-off flag; paired dev gate vs EGO2048)
H3 within-game hit credit (reward shaping; requires owner approval before any admission)
evidence: EGO2048 self-play collapsed to a single action by game 1920; root policy target pinned at 25/32; hits per game flat at 4.1; value MSE flat at 0.2
EGO4096 dev bouts: no improvement on any opponent; both EGO arms win about 25 percent at seat 0 and 82 percent at seat 1 vs E1024
decision.reason: The data support a degenerate symmetric self-play equilibrium rather than under-training; a partner pool attacks that mechanism without changing the objective, while replication tests seed stability.
decision.next_action: Admit lane rep when free space reaches 9.55 GB; review and admit EGO-POOL2048 after its tests and pushed commit are verified; ask the owner about H3.
